# Resource: ctyun_iam_saml_provider

Provides an IAM resource to manage the IAM SAML 2.0 provider.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ctyun_iam_saml_provider" "example-provider" {
  name = "example-provider"
  saml_metadata_document = <<EOF
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<md:EntityDescriptor xmlns:md="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:metadata" entityID="https://example.com" validUntil="2030-08-31T16:30:00Z">
  <md:IDPSSODescriptor WantAuthnRequestsSigned="false" protocolSupportEnumeration="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:protocol">
    <md:KeyDescriptor use="signing">
      <ds:KeyInfo xmlns:ds="http://www.w3.org/2000/09/xmldsig#">
        <ds:X509Data>
          <ds:X509Certificate></ds:X509Certificate>
        </ds:X509Data>
      </ds:KeyInfo>
    </md:KeyDescriptor>
    <md:NameIDFormat>urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:unspecified</md:NameIDFormat>
    <md:SingleSignOnService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST" Location="https://example.com/idp/endpoint/HttpPost"/>
    <md:SingleSignOnService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-Redirect" Location="https://example.com/idp/endpoint/HttpRedirect"/>
  </md:IDPSSODescriptor>
</md:EntityDescriptor>
EOF
}
```

## Argument Reference

This resource supports the following arguments:

* `name` - (Required, ForceNew) The name of the SAML 2.0 identity provider. The value is a string of 1 to 128 letters, numbers, or special characters. The special characters only include underscores (`_`), hyphens (`-`), comma (`,`), period (`.`), plus sign (`+`), equal sign (`=`), and at sign (`@`).
* `saml_metadata_document` - (Required) An XML document generated by an identity provider that supports SAML 2.0. The value is a string of length 1,000 to 10,000,000.

## Attribute Reference

This resource exports the following attributes in addition to the arguments above:

* `arn` - Resource name of the SAML 2.0 identity provider.
* `id` - Resource name of the SAML 2.0 identity provider.
* `saml_provider_uuid` - The unique ID of the SAML 2.0 identity provider.
* `valid_until` - The expiration time of the SAML 2.0 identity provider.

## Import

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the `identity` attribute of an `import` block can be used to import an existing IAM SAML provider:

```terraform
import {
  to = ctyun_iam_saml_provider.example-provider
  identity = {
    arn = "arn:ctyun:iam::1234567890123:saml-provider/example-provider"
  }
}
```

### Identity Schema

#### Required

* `arn` - Resource name of the SAML 2.0 identity provider.

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an `import` block with the SAML provider ARN as the ID:

```terraform
import {
  to = ctyun_iam_saml_provider.example-provider
  id = "arn:ctyun:iam::1234567890123:saml-provider/example-provider"
}
```

Using `terraform import`, import an IAM SAML provider using the SAML provider ARN:

```console
terraform import ctyun_iam_saml_provider.example-provider arn:ctyun:iam::1234567890123:saml-provider/example-provider
```
